items.source: By default false in which case ConstraintViolationException is raised in case of violations. When set to true, MethodValidationException is raised instead with the method validation results.
items.translation: 默认情况下为false，在这种情况下，如果发生违规将抛出ConstraintViolationException。当设置为true时，将抛出MethodValidationException，并附带方法验证结果。

items.source: Target classes with such annotated methods need to be annotated with Spring's Validated annotation at the type level, for their methods to be searched for inline constraint annotations. Validation groups can be specified through @Validated as well. By default, JSR-303 will validate against its default group only.
items.translation: 带有此类注释的方法的目标类需要在类型级别上标注 Spring 的Validated 注解，以便搜索其方法中的内联约束注解。验证组也可以通过@Validated指定。默认情况下，JSR-303 仅针对其默认组进行验证。

items.source:
This setter property exists so that developers can provide their own
(non-Spring-specific) annotation type to indicate that a class is supposed
to be validated in the sense of applying method validation.
items.translation: 此 Setter 属性存在，以便开发人员提供自己的（非 Spring 特定）注解类型，以指示该类应进行验证，即应用方法验证。

items.source: Default is the default ValidatorFactory's default Validator.
items.translation: 默认值是默认 ValidatorFactory 的默认 Validator。

items.source: Whether to adapt ConstraintViolations to MethodValidationResult.
items.translation: 是否将 `ConstraintViolation` 适配为 MethodValidationResult。

items.source:
Create AOP advice for method validation purposes, to be applied
with a pointcut for the specified 'validated' annotation.
items.translation: 为方法验证目的创建 AOP 建议，并将其与指定 `validated` 注解的点切面一起应用。

items.source: Set a lazily initialized Validator to delegate to for validating methods.
items.translation: 设置一个懒加载的 Validator 作为委托对象，用于验证方法。

items.source: the interceptor to use (typically, but not necessarily, a MethodValidationInterceptor or subclass thereof)
items.translation: 要使用的拦截器（通常是，但不一定是`MethodValidationInterceptor`或其子类）

items.source: validatedAnnotationType - the desired annotation type
items.translation: validatedAnnotationType - 期望的注解类型

items.source: In case of validation errors, the interceptor can raise ConstraintViolationException, or adapt the violations to MethodValidationResult and raise MethodValidationException.
items.translation: 在出现验证错误时，拦截器可以抛出ConstraintViolationException，或者将违规项适配为MethodValidationResult并抛出MethodValidationException。

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.
items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在设置所有 bean 属性并满足BeanFactoryAware、ApplicationContextAware等接口后调用。

items.source: Description copied from interface: InitializingBean
items.translation: 描述从接口复制：InitializingBean

items.source: Set the 'validated' annotation type.
items.translation: 设置“validated”注解类型。

items.source: Set the JSR-303 Validator to delegate to for validating methods.
items.translation: 将 JSR-303 验证器设置为用于验证方法的委托。

items.source:
Set the JSR-303 ValidatorFactory to delegate to for validating methods,
using its default Validator.
items.translation: 将 JSR-303 ValidatorFactory 设置为用于验证方法的委托目标，并使用其默认 Validator。

items.source: afterPropertiesSet in interface InitializingBean
items.translation: `afterPropertiesSet` 接口中的 `InitializingBean`

items.translation: validator - 用于 Validator 的 Supplier
